_README: Your ranks for the ticker at the top of the site. This file wins over anything the model generates.
1. Put names in the order you want, top first. That's it.
3. Commit and push. Vercel redeploys on its own.
- A tab you leave as [] uses the generated order. Fill in one tab or all five.
- Names are matched against data/projections-2026.json to pull team and projected PPG.
Spelling has to match, but case doesn't.
- Rank someone who isn't in the projections and it still works — the row just shows
no PPG rather than a made-up number. The build prints those names so you can see them.
- For a player with no projection, use {"name": "Player", "team": "BUF", "pos": "WR"}
instead of a plain string if you want the team and badge to show.
- Bad JSON aborts the build instead of publishing a half-right board. A trailing comma
after the last item in a list is the usual culprit.
The 'overall' tab is the cross-positional one. The model orders it by VORP, which puts
no QB in the top 24 — correct for 1QB scoring, but override it here if you'd rather the
board read like a draft list.
